entries.9e13a138350e1a5c: It conducts the manufacture and sale of semiconductor test equipment as a single business. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥5,567 million, accounting for all consolidated revenue. The company and four consolidated subsidiaries (TESEC,INC., TESEC(M)SDN.BHD., Taisai Kokusai Boeki (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. and Ryōkō Onden Denki Co., Ltd.) make up the group; the company develops, manufactures and sells handlers, testers and parts, among others, and provides after-sales service; the overseas subsidiaries sell the company's products and provide after-sales service; and Ryōkō Onden Denki develops, manufactures and sells semiconductor measuring instruments and provides after-sales service. Its main locations are the head office (Higashiyamato, Tokyo) and the Ina Office (Minowa, Kamiina District, Nagano Prefecture).
entries.9fb15e41cea6b2b7: These are measuring instruments that evaluate the electrical characteristics and performance of semiconductors. Centered on power semiconductors, it develops, manufactures and sells testers for discrete devices and ICs, among others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,974 million.
entries.d0038854a9b3317c: This is equipment that conveys semiconductor devices of various shapes and automatically sorts and stores them according to set criteria, based on measurement data from connected testers. Examples include MAP handlers and handlers for power devices. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,547 million.
entries.e03a4b4efb2dab47: This is the sale of parts and other items, centered on change kits for modifying handlers. The transactions are based on the number of the company's handlers in operation; revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,046 million.
entries.edebe2d14dac4c64: A semiconductor test equipment manufacturer that makes and sells testers used to inspect semiconductor devices and handlers that transport and sort the devices.
